description: This file contains cryptographic functions related to safe prime generation, modular arithmetic, and primality testing, specifically for the SRP (Secure Remote Password) protocol. It includes functions for generating safe primes, checking primality, modular exponentiation, and Montgomery multiplication, with references to big number operations and cryptographic algorithms.

methods.name: t_makeconfent
methods.description: Generates a configuration entry with a safe prime modulus and generator for cryptographic protocols, based on specified key size.

methods.name: t_makeconfent_c
methods.description: Generates a configuration entry with a custom-sized safe prime, using a different prime generation method.

methods.name: t_newconfent
methods.description: Initializes a new configuration entry with default values.

methods.name: t_putconfent
methods.description: Outputs a configuration entry to a file in base64-encoded format.

methods.name: BigIntegerBitLen
methods.description: Returns the bit length of a big integer.

methods.name: BigIntegerCheckPrime
methods.description: Performs a probabilistic primality test on a big integer.

methods.name: BigIntegerModInt
methods.description: Computes the modulus of a big integer with an unsigned int.

methods.name: BigIntegerMod
methods.description: Computes the modulus of a big integer with another big integer.

methods.name: BigIntegerLShift
methods.description: Performs a left shift on a big integer by a specified number of bits.
